questions.question: When must you show proof of insurance to police?

options.text: Only after a crash.
After a crash or when stopped for a ticket.
Only when stopped and given a ticket.

questions.correctAnswerText: After a crash or when stopped for a ticket.
questions.explanation: You must carry proof of insurance when you drive. You must show your insurance proof and license to a police officer if they ask after a traffic stop or crash.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right.
Right turns are not allowed.
You can turn right on a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right turns are not allowed.
questions.explanation: This sign means no right turns are permitted. It is illegal to turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: Because motorcycles, scooters, and mopeds are hard to see, you should:

options.text: Drive slower.
Keep checking your mirrors and blind spots.
Share a lane with a motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep checking your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and easy to miss. They can hide in your blind spot. You must always watch carefully for motorcycles, mopeds, and scooters.

questions.question: You should use your headlights on rainy, snowy, or foggy days because:

options.text: It keeps your engine warm.
Other drivers can see your vehicle better.
It warns others about the bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: Other drivers can see your vehicle better.
questions.explanation: In bad weather, other drivers have trouble seeing your vehicle. Headlights make your car easier to see. If you turn on your windshield wipers, you must also turn on your low beam headlights.

questions.question: At a red light with a green arrow, you can go in the direction of the arrow if you:

options.text: Come to a complete stop first.
Wait for the light to change.
Are in the correct lane and the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are in the correct lane and the intersection is clear.
questions.explanation: You can proceed in the direction of a green arrow if you are in the correct lane. The intersection must be clear. You must let pedestrians and other vehicles in the intersection pass first.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow light mean?

options.text: Slow down and be careful.
Stop as fast as you can.
Stop and go only when the intersection is empty.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be careful.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop at a flashing yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn.
Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.
Curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers which way they must go. You must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in both directions.
The road curves ahead.
School zone with crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in both directions.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are leaving a divided road. You are entering a highway where traffic travels in both directions.

questions.question: When turning left, you must let pass:

options.text: Oncoming cars going straight or turning right.
Cars that are passing you.
No one in particular.

questions.correctAnswerText: Oncoming cars going straight or turning right.
questions.explanation: When turning left, you must yield to all vehicles coming from the opposite direction. This includes bicycles and motorcycles.

questions.question: What does a defensive driver do?

options.text: Assumes other drivers will do the right thing.
Thinks about what other drivers might do and is ready to react.
Expects no help from others and gives none.

questions.correctAnswerText: Thinks about what other drivers might do and is ready to react.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means expecting mistakes from other drivers and being ready to handle them.

questions.question: You are coming to an intersection with a flashing red light. What should you do?

options.text: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Stop completely, check for traffic, and go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely, check for traffic, and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, let other vehicles and pedestrians go first, then proceed when safe.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, what must you do?

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks with hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from either direction.
Both of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both of the above.
questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with great care. Only cross when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Also watch for vehicles like school buses and hazardous material trucks, which must stop at all railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink and drive.
The road is slippery when wet.
The road curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Stop before crossing the intersection.
Slow down and proceed carefully.
Wait for a green light before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down, check for traffic coming from the sides, and then proceed carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Services are available for drivers.
Construction and road work ahead.
Distance information to nearby locations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Services are available for drivers.
questions.explanation: Blue signs give information about services for drivers. They show locations of rest areas, food, gas stations, hospitals, and other helpful services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn left here.
You can turn left only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn left here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: At a red traffic light with a green arrow, when may you proceed?

options.text: After you come to a complete stop.
When the light changes to green.
When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are in the correct lane and the road is clear.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in that direction if you are in the correct lane and the way is clear. You can do this even if the main light is red.

questions.question: When driving through a construction zone, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to watch the workers.
Drive closer to the car in front of you.
Drive carefully through and do not slow down to look at things.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through and do not slow down to look at things.
questions.explanation: Do not slow down to look at unusual things in construction zones. This slowing causes traffic congestion. Drive carefully but keep moving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Curves are ahead.
A divided highway is starting.
A divided highway is ending.

questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway is ending.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: As you drive faster, what becomes more important?

options.text: Turn on your headlights.
Look far ahead on the road.
Change lanes frequently.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look far ahead on the road.
questions.explanation: Your vehicle needs more distance to stop as you drive faster. Looking far ahead gives you time to see hazards and react safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
Merge right.
Turn left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right side.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Straight ahead
Right, toward the side of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the side of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill, turn your wheels right toward the road edge. If your brakes fail, your car will roll away from traffic. When parking uphill on a road with a curb, turn your wheels left so the car rolls into the curb.

questions.question: When changing lanes:

options.text: Rely on the rearview mirror.
Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
Rely on the left side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look over your shoulder in the direction you plan to move.
questions.explanation: Always look over your shoulder to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes. Check several times and watch both the road ahead and the lane next to you.

questions.question: The center line has one solid yellow line and one broken yellow line. If the broken line is next to your lane, it means:

options.text: You are not allowed to pass in this area.
You can pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is present.
You can only make right turns in this area.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass other vehicles on the left if no oncoming traffic is present.
questions.explanation: When a broken yellow line is on your side, you are in a passing zone. You can pass other vehicles if it is safe and no oncoming traffic is coming.

questions.question: You have a green light and there are pedestrians in the intersection. What should you do?

options.text: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
You have the right-of-way over pedestrians.
Pedestrians must wait for you to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must yield the right-of-way to pedestrians.
questions.explanation: Even with a green light, you must yield to pedestrians already in the intersection. Always give pedestrians the right-of-way when turning.

questions.question: If there is a deep puddle on the road ahead, you should:

options.text: Maintain speed to drive through the water.
Avoid the puddle if possible.
Shift into neutral as you drive through the water.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid the puddle if possible.
questions.explanation: Avoid puddles and other slippery areas like ice, wet leaves, and oil. The safest driving surface is dry and solid.

questions.question: If you are driving on a highway next to a broken white line, you:

options.text: cannot cross the line to pass.
may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
may only cross to change lanes if you are in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: may cross the line to pass and change lanes.
questions.explanation: White dashed lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross a dashed white line to pass or change lanes if it is safe to do so.

questions.question: If bad weather makes it hard to see clearly, you should:

options.text: Speed up to get off the road quickly.
Drive in the lane closest to oncoming traffic.
Increase your following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase your following distance.
questions.explanation: In poor visibility or darkness, increase the distance between you and the car ahead. This gives you more time to react to hazards you cannot see.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep grade ahead.
Winding road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign means a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.
